theme_strategy.description: A 'Transit Authority' aesthetic prioritizing extreme clarity, functional beauty, and trust for handling payments. Abandons typical soft e-commerce UI for a more structured, neo-brutalist, data-forward approach.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold

rules: No generic sans for headings (Inter banned).
Use JetBrains Mono for all terminal codes, times, prices, and reference IDs.
Headings must have tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Optical alignment with a strict visible grid. Expose the skeleton of the UI.

grids.search_hero: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-1 items-end bg-black/10 border border-black/10 p-1 rounded-sm

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-black/10

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#002FA7]/90 font-bold tracking-wide uppercase px-8 py-4 transition-colors duration-150
buttons.accent: bg-[#FF4500] text-white hover:bg-[#E03C00] shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(255,69,0,0.39)] hover:shadow-[0_6px_20px_rgba(255,69,0,0.23)] hover:-translate-y-[1px] transition-all duration-200
buttons.outline: bg-transparent border border-black/20 text-primary hover:border-black/50 hover:bg-black/5 transition-colors duration-150

inputs.search_hero_input: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold bg-white border-none focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-black/20 h-20 px-6
inputs.standard: border border-black/20 bg-white focus:border-[#002FA7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#002FA7] transition-all rounded-sm
inputs.label: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 block

cards.default: bg-white border border-black/10 p-6 md:p-8 rounded-sm hover:border-black/30 transition-colors

seat_selection.seat_available: w-12 h-14 border border-black/20 rounded-md hover:border-[#002FA7] hover:text-[#002FA7] transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-xs font-bold
seat_selection.seat_selected: w-12 h-14 bg-[#FF4500] text-white rounded-md shadow-md flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-xs font-bold ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#FF4500]
seat_selection.seat_booked: w-12 h-14 border border-black/10 bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-xs cursor-not-allowed opacity-60

motion.philosophy: Utilitarian and rapid. No bouncy easings.

icons.style: duotone for marketing graphics, bold/regular for UI controls

media.rules: Never use placeholder images. Use standard generic avatars or the provided Unsplash URLs.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1). Selected states use high-contrast orange/white.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='seat-btn-1A', data-testid='search-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'JetBrains Mono' are imported via Google Fonts or Fontsource.
Build the hero search form as a dense, grid-based component resembling a physical control board (Bento Grid Style).

For the Seat Selection map, avoid pure HTML generic radio buttons; build a visual grid using 'div/button' with clear 'Available/Selected/Booked' states. Use Phosphor Icons for the steering wheel/driver position.
Payment Gateway section (Stripe/iPay88) should be styled purely functionally with crisp borders. Do not use heavy shadows.
Ensure the application strictly follows mobile-first design as this UI will influence React Native down the line.
Never use generic Shadcn soft cards. Strip away 'shadow-sm' and 'rounded-xl' from standard components, replacing them with 'rounded-sm' and 'border-black/10'.
